observations.seen: Frame 1 has a blown-out white floor patch under the far ceiling strip, so the chest and floor detail wash out. Elsewhere the corridors are evenly lit with little falloff or contrast, and a light hits each surface the same way.

The treasure chest, wall pipes, wooden doors and the round vault door on its black box cast no visible shadows. Wall-to-floor and wall-to-ceiling junctions show almost no contact darkening or ambient occlusion.

Frame 4's floor shows faint smeared reflections of the ceiling strip. The pool in frame 3 is a flat, uniform teal plane with a hard rectangular edge and no reflection or refraction. The gun metal reads matte with weak specular.

Every level is a long rectangular box corridor with straight pipe rails and yellow floor strips. The only features are a few repeated props (wooden doors, a round hatch), so the floors look generic and interchangeable.
Frame 2 has green haze and dust sparkles, but they sit on top of the scene as a flat milky veil. The fog does not add depth layering, and frame 4 has a similar uniform brown haze.

The stone wall texture repeats visibly and looks low-resolution up close in frame 2. The frame 1 ceiling has a blotchy, noisy dark texture. The plain walls in frame 4 are flat beige with no wear or roughness variation. The chest in frame 1 renders semi-transparent and glowing yellow.

The round vault door in frame 4 is mounted on a plain black cube that floats in the corridor. The architecture is untrimmed box geometry. The rifle and pistol viewmodels have reasonable detail but faceted low-poly silhouettes.
Every shot is a centered one-point-perspective corridor with nothing in the middle ground. In frames 3 and 4 the pistol sits small in mid-right screen and blocks the view without framing it.
The pistol in frames 3 and 4 floats detached from the bottom edge and looks unanchored to any hand. The FOV is acceptable, but the rifle in frame 2 fills most of the right half of the screen.
Bloom is heavy: the frame 2 muzzle and pickup orbs flare into large white blobs, and the frame 1 floor clips to white. Film grain and a milky lifted-black grade flatten contrast in all frames.

nextChange.change: raise shadow strength toward the look target and pull the key light to an angle that throws visible contact shadows
